name: Clear Spindle (Ioun Stone)
body:
Aura strong varied; CL 12th; Slot —; Price 4,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This stone sustains the wearer without food or water.

Cracked: This stone sustains the wearer on half the normal amount of food. Price: 1,000 gp.

Flawed: This stone sustains the wearer without food but he must consume twice the normal amount of water. Price: 2,000 gp.

See Inferior Ioun Stones for details on cracked and flawed variant stones.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Special creator must be 12th level; Cost 2,000 gp.
